Script.name: loader
Script.script:
chimera_vip_package = chimera_vip_package or {} local I = chimera_vip_package
I.root = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/ChimeraVIP" I.loader = I.root .. "/loader.lua" I.url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gnomidlo/ChimeraVIP/main/loader.lua" I.handlers = I.handlers or {}
local function ensure_dir(path) local ok, lfs = pcall(require, "lfs") if not ok then return false end local sep = package.config:sub(1, 1) local current, prefix = "", "" if path:match("^%a:[/\\]") then prefix = path:sub(1, 2) .. sep path = path:sub(4) elseif path:sub(1, 1) == sep then prefix = sep path = path:sub(2) end current = prefix for part in path:gmatch("[^/\\]+") do if current ~= "" and current:sub(-1) ~= sep then current = current .. sep end current = current .. part lfs.mkdir(current) end return true end
local function exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close(); return true end return false end
local function cleanup() if I.handlers.done then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, I.handlers.done) end if I.handlers.error then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, I.handlers.error) end I.handlers.done, I.handlers.error = nil, nil end
local function run_loader() local ok, err = pcall(dofile, I.loader) if not ok then cecho("\n<orange>[ChimeraVIP]<reset> Nie udalo sie uruchomic loadera: " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end end
if exists(I.loader) then run_loader() else ensure_dir(I.root) cleanup() cecho("\n<aquamarine>[ChimeraVIP]<reset> Instalacja - pobieram loader...\n")
I.handlers.done = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", function(_, filename) if filename ~= I.loader then return end cleanup() run_loader() end)
I.handlers.error = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", function(_, err, filename) if filename ~= I.loader then return end cleanup() cecho("\n<orange>[ChimeraVIP]<reset> Nie udalo sie pobrac loadera: " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end)
downloadFile(I.loader, I.url) end
